events.description: Called with the kept rectangle, in the image's pixels, after each move or zoom.
events.name: onCropChange

props.description: The cropper's accessible name, for example "Crop your profile photo"; defaults to the catalogue's "Crop image".
props.name: label

props.description: The frame's width over its height. Defaults to 1, a square.
props.name: aspectRatio

props.description: `rect`, or `round` for an avatar (the crop is still the square around the circle). Defaults to `rect`.
props.name: shape

props.description: The largest zoom, as a multiple of the image just covering the frame. Defaults to 3.
props.name: maxZoom
